unresolved: entry price never stated in any post text
stop level never stated as an absolute price; 'Trailing full' describes a trailing-stop mechanism without a number
'10% up from Entry' is an interim unrealized gain on an open position, not a stated final result -- not recorded as net_result_pct
'These Quickly Risk Free Trades' reads as a general description of this trade archetype, not an unambiguous statement that this specific stop was moved to breakeven
attached chart images carry 'E' entry markers and percentage callouts with no explicit numeric price label attached to them
an attached order-confirmation screenshot shows a fill price but is a broker order table, not a price chart, and is marked unreadable by the vision pass

notes: This is the thinnest of the three fixtures on purpose: post text is only '#FCL', '#FCL Almost at the 10% circuit now...', and '#FCL - 10% up from Entry...'. No post ever states a number in text.

MOST CONSEQUENTIAL JUDGMENT CALL of this wave: the root post's second image is a broker buy-order confirmation showing Price 39.05 -- a human glancing at it would call that the entry price. Read literally, vision.md rule 5 ('If the image is not a price chart... set unreadable: true') marks any non-chart screenshot unreadable, and an order-confirmation table is not a price chart. So under a faithful implementation of the CURRENT vision prompt, that 39.05 is never surfaced to the reconciler, and entries stays empty. This is the correct behavior of vision.py as specified, and it is also the more conservative, harder-to-get-wrong reading given 'a wrong price is worse than a missing one'. But it does mean a real, useful, unambiguous number goes unused. Flagging this for the maintainer: extending vision.md (or adding a separate broker-screenshot prompt) to cover order/holdings/position tables would recover this evidence type, which recurs across at least 3 of the 9 real images in this sample (RATEGAIN holdings, FCL positions list, this order confirmation). Not changed in this wave -- out of the authorized llm/reconcile.py + llm/vision.py + tests scope, and editing a prompt requires re-running the whole golden suite per AGENTS.md.

'10% up from Entry' is deliberately NOT net_result_pct: net_result_pct is defined as the trade's stated result, and this position is still open ('Trailing full' = full size still held, no exit stated anywhere in the thread). An interim unrealized-gain mention on an open position is commentary, not a result.

'These Quickly Risk Free Trades' is genuine, defensible-either-way ambiguity: it could mean 'this specific FCL stop is now at breakeven' (as in the Fastzonetrader fixture's unambiguous 'Everything risk free now'), or it could be a general remark about this trader's preferred trade archetype ('these [kind of] quickly-risk-free trades'). Given the ambiguity and the ban on inferring an unstated number anyway (no absolute stop price exists to record even if the move were certain), this was left out of `stop` and recorded in `unresolved` instead.
